@copilot 浏览器中预览界面显示空白。

> @copilot 浏览器中预览界面显示空白。

Root cause: the `useEffect` for tracking recent items had unstable array references (`cleanParts` from `.filter()`, `allObjects` from `|| []`) in its dependency array. These created new arrays on every render, causing an infinite loop (React error #185: maximum update depth exceeded).

Fixed in `a9898a2` — derived values are now computed inside the effect body, with only `location.pathname` and the stable `addRecentItem` callback as dependencies.

![Console rendering correctly after fix](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/e9cac4fb-69e2-4553-ac0b-590377ceb8ac)
